acquisition_method: Mass spectrometry data was acquired in a data directed manner for 90 min in positive mode.
alkylation_concentration: After shearing, samples were alkylated by the addition of 8 µL of 500 mM iodoacetamide (Sigma, I1149) and incubated for 30 min in the dark.
alkylation_reagent: After shearing, samples were alkylated by the addition of 8 µL of 500 mM iodoacetamide (Sigma, I1149) and incubated for 30 min in the dark.
cleavage_agent: In-column digest was performed by adding 25 µL of a 0.8 µg/µL trypsin solution (proteomics grade trypsin; Promega, V5111) in 50 mM TEAB pH 8.0 in accordance with the manufacturer’s protocol for 1-hour digestion.
collision_energy: The MS2 Resolution was set to 30,000, with an AGC target of 2e5, a maximum fill time of 45 ms, isolation window of 1.3Th and a collision energy of 28.
fragmentation_method: inferred: The instrument is a Q Exactive HF and the collision energy is set to 28 (normalized collision energy), which is characteristic of Higher-energy C-trap Dissociation (HCD) on Orbitrap instruments.
instrument: Lyophilized peptides were resuspended in 10 μL of a 5% acetonitrile, 0.1% formic acid solution and evaluated by liquid chromatography (LC) coupled tandem MS (LC-MS/MS) using an UltiMate® 3000 Rapid Separation LC system (RSLC, Dionex Corporation, Sunnyvale, CA) coupled to a Q Exactive HF mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher).
ionization_type: inferred: The instrument is a Q Exactive HF connected to an LC system, which uses Electrospray Ionization (ESI) as standard for LC-MS/MS.
labeling: inferred: No isobaric labels were used in this study.
mass_analyzer: inferred: The instrument model Q Exactive HF contains an Orbitrap mass analyzer.
ptm: alkylated cysteine residues, oxidized methionine, hydroxylation of asparagine, aspartic acid, proline or lysine, phosphorylation of serine, tyrosine, threonine

The peptide database was modified to search for alkylated cysteine residues (monoisotopic mass change, +57.021 Da) as a fixed modification, with oxidized methionine (+ 15.995 Da), hydroxylation of asparagine, aspartic acid, proline or lysine (+ 15.995 Da) and phosphorylation of serine, tyrosine, threonine (+ 79.966 Da) as variable modifications.
